For Elite Business Bay, only the 2BR is available right now. On the yearly question, we work on monthly bookings and can lock in the rate for 3-month blocks. No Ejari contracts, but you can stay as long as you like with the rate reviewed every 3 months. Does the 2BR work for you, or would you prefer the studio or 1BR nearby?
